headline: Brazil Lower House Approves Base Text of Fiscal Adjustment Package
summary: Brazil's Chamber of Deputies passed the base text of a fiscal adjustment package aiming for expenditure cuts to achieve a primary budget surplus of approximately R$18.7 billion.
why: Brazil's fiscal trajectory heavily influences domestic interest rates, sovereign credit standing, and investor sentiment across Latin American markets.

impacts.name: Ibovespa
impacts.why: Brazilian equities reacted as lawmakers approved the base text of the government's fiscal spending cuts.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Brazilian assets moved as the Chamber of Deputies passed the main text of government fiscal adjustment measures.
